# GoRoute AI Control Plane

> GoRoute AI Control Plane is a 100% pure Go Enterprise AI Control Plane and embeddable Go SDK spanning five core modules: 1. AI Gateway (23 /v1 routes, 73+ provider profiles, adaptive load balancing, circuit breakers, exact-match cache), 2. AI Governance (Virtual API Keys, RBAC, AES-256-GCM vault, guardrails, SSRF protection), 3. AI FinOps (64-bit micro-dollar accounting, sliding-window rate limits, pre-flight tokenization), 4. AI Observability (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Operator Web UI), and 5. AI Agent Management (MCP Virtual Hub, A2A protocol, autonomous tool loops).

- Canonical Site: https://goroute-ai.github.io/
- Full Documentation Corpus: https://goroute-ai.github.io/llms-full.txt

## Guides & Platform Documentation

- [GoRoute AI Control Plane Overview](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/getting-started/overview): Understand the GoRoute Enterprise AI Control Plane, its 5 core modules, deployment modes, high-performance architecture, and embedded Operator UI.
- [System Architecture & Topology](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/getting-started/architecture): Deep dive into the GoRoute Enterprise AI Control Plane architecture, its 5 core modules, 10-step request lifecycle, multi-layer caching, and persistence layer.
- [Quickstart — Go SDK](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/getting-started/quickstart-sdk): Install the GoRoute SDK, configure a model, and make your first chat request.
- [Quickstart — Docker Compose](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/getting-started/quickstart-docker): Deploy GoRoute AI Gateway with PostgreSQL 16+ and Redis 7+ using Docker Compose and explore the Operator UI.
- [Quickstart — Standalone Gateway CLI](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/getting-started/quickstart-cli): Install GoRoute AI Gateway via the universal shell installer or source, configure providers, and interact with the Operator UI.
- [Developer Learning Path](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/getting-started/learning-path): A step-by-step route through GoRoute for Go developers and gateway operators.
- [1. AI Gateway — Traffic Management & Model Routing](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/modules/ai-gateway): Unified LLM proxy with 23 /v1 routes, 73+ provider profiles, complexity routing, 5 load-balancing strategies, circuit breakers, and 2-tier caching.
- [Chat Completions API](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/data-plane/chat-completions): 100% OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint standardizing reasoning effort, role alternation, dynamic provider routing, and telemetry headers.
- [Anthropic Messages Ingress API](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/data-plane/messages): Native Anthropic Messages API ingress and pre-flight token counting with thinking blocks, tool translation, and strict alternating turn consolidation.
- [Legacy Text Completions API](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/data-plane/completions): OpenAI-compatible text completions endpoint supporting raw prompt text, prompt arrays, parameter controls, and token usage accounting.
- [Function & Tool Calling](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/data-plane/tool-calling): Standardized tool calling across OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini with strict schema enforcement and Model Context Protocol (MCP) alignment.
- [Model Management & Access Control](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/data-plane/model-management): The 4-layer model access control hierarchy, tri-state capability verification, pricing provenance, and declarative model routing groups.
- [Embeddings API](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/data-plane/embeddings): Dense vector embeddings across OpenAI, Google Gemini, Mistral, Cohere Embed v3, and Voyage AI with base64 encoding and dimension reduction.
- [Document Reranking API](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/data-plane/rerank): Unified document reranking across Cohere v2 and Jina AI with structured rank fields, top_n filtering, and micro-dollar search unit accounting.
- [Audio Transcription, Translation & Speech API](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/data-plane/audio): High-throughput audio transcription (Whisper STT), translation, and speech synthesis (TTS) with retryable disk spooling and precision integer FinOps.
- [Image Generation, Edits & Variations API](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/data-plane/images): OpenAI-compatible image generations, edits, and variations across DALL-E 2/3 and Google Imagen with quality tiers and resolution-based FinOps pricing.
- [OpenAI Realtime WebSocket Protocol](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/data-plane/realtime): Full-duplex speech and text sessions over WebSockets using nhooyr.io/websocket connection hijacking, event streaming, and session FinOps.
- [Stateful Tenant Files API](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/data-plane/files): Multi-tenant file storage with streaming SHA-256 hashing, 0700/0600 POSIX permissions, PostgreSQL indexing, and OpenAI Files compatibility.
- [Asynchronous Batch Processing API](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/data-plane/batches): Asynchronous batch processing with 24-hour turnaround SLA, 50% off-peak cost discount, state transitions, and JSONL input/output pipelines.
- [OpenAI Responses API](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/data-plane/responses): OpenAI Responses API specification supporting instructions, polymorphic input, synchronous JSON, and multi-event SSE streaming.
- [Content Moderation API](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/data-plane/moderations): Fail-closed content moderation via OpenAI omni-moderation-latest with category flags, granular confidence scores, and virtual key security boundaries.
- [Fast Heuristic Tokenization API](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/data-plane/tokenize): Zero-latency in-process token counting approximating family-specific BPE and SentencePiece vocabularies without external network calls.
- [Providers Overview](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/providers/overview): Complete provider matrix covering all 73 supported upstream ProviderType profiles, modalities, operation enforcement, and authentication mechanisms.
- [OpenAI](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/providers/openai): OpenAI provider integration for chat, reasoning, images, audio, embeddings, Responses API, and Realtime WebSockets.
- [Anthropic Claude](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/providers/anthropic-claude): Anthropic provider integration for Claude Messages API, extended thinking, and role alternation tool consolidation.
- [Google Gemini](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/providers/google-gemini): Google Gemini provider integration for chat, embeddings, multimodal inputs, image generation, audio, and thinking budgets.
- [AWS Bedrock](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/providers/aws-bedrock): Native AWS Bedrock adapter with SigV4 signing, IAM auth, and Converse API.
- [Google Cloud Vertex AI](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/providers/google-vertex): Google Cloud Vertex AI provider integration with Service Account auth, OAuth2 token caching, and Gemini models.
- [Azure OpenAI Service](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/providers/azure-openai): Native Azure OpenAI Service adapter with API key, Entra ID token auth, custom deployment mapping, and version pinning.
- [Cohere](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/providers/cohere): Native Cohere v2 adapter for Command R/R+, Embed v3, Rerank v3.5, and micro-dollar search unit FinOps accounting.
- [Mistral AI](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/providers/mistral): Native Mistral AI provider adapter for Mistral Large, Codestral, Pixtral, and Embeddings.
- [Ollama](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/providers/ollama): Native Ollama provider adapter for local inference, model auto-discovery, and streaming NDJSON translation.
- [OpenAI-Compatible Dialects](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/providers/openai-compatible): Comprehensive guide to the certified OpenAI-compatible dialect profiles and domain providers.
- [Custom In-House Providers](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/providers/custom-provider): Register and configure custom in-house OpenAI-compatible deployments in configs/config.yaml.
- [Stage 1 — Zero-LLM Complexity Classifier](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/routing-resiliency/complexity-classifier): Route simple and complex prompts to different model tiers with GoRoute's fast heuristic classifier, without calling another LLM.
- [Stage 2 — EWMA Load Balancing](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/routing-resiliency/load-balancing): Compare GoRoute's five model routing strategies, including weighted shuffle, least busy, usage headroom, and latency-based EWMA balancing.
- [3-State Circuit Breakers](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/routing-resiliency/circuit-breakers): Learn how GoRoute's healthy, open, and half-open circuit breaker states isolate failing AI providers and limit cascading request failures.
- [Retries & Fallback Cascades](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/routing-resiliency/fallbacks-and-retries): Configure retries and cross-provider fallback cascades in GoRoute to keep AI requests available during upstream timeouts, rate limits, and outages.
- [Deterministic Exact-Match Cache](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/finops-and-security/exact-match-cache): Configure GoRoute's tenant-isolated exact-match response cache for deterministic requests, using SHA-256 cache keys and memory or Redis storage.
- [2. AI Governance — Security, Policies & Compliance](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/modules/ai-governance): Enterprise 4-layer policy enforcement, Operator RBAC with OIDC/JWT, AES-256-GCM Credentials Vault, Virtual Keys, streaming guardrails, and SSRF egress firewall.
- [Scoped Virtual Keys & Quotas](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/finops-and-security/virtual-keys): Create scoped GoRoute virtual API keys with model allowlists, organization and team access, spend budgets, and request or token quotas.
- [RBAC & Key Vault Architecture](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/finops-and-security/rbac-and-vault): Learn how GoRoute separates client virtual keys from provider credentials with four-layer role-based access control and an AES-256-GCM key vault.
- [Organization Guardrails](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/finops-and-security/guardrails): Configure request blocking, secret and PII handling, and output redaction for an organization.
- [Network Security & SSRF Protection](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/finops-and-security/ssrf-and-network): See how GoRoute blocks server-side request forgery with outbound network controls that protect cloud metadata, private IP ranges, and internal services.
- [Production Readiness Checklist](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/operations/production-checklist): Production checklist for GoRoute AI Gateway: SSRF firewall, secret validation, RBAC/OIDC, fail-closed rate limits, circuit breakers, and load testing.
- [3. AI FinOps — Cost Management & Optimization](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/modules/ai-finops): Exact 64-bit integer micro-dollar accounting, modality pricing, budget reservations, PostgreSQL outboxes, and Redis Lua sliding-window rate limits.
- [Cost Accounting and Spend Records](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/finops-and-security/micro-dollar-ledger): Understand integer micro-dollar cost calculation and asynchronous spend persistence.
- [Distributed Rate Limiting (RPM & TPM)](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/finops-and-security/sliding-window-ratelimit): Enforce distributed requests-per-minute and tokens-per-minute quotas with GoRoute's atomic Redis Lua sliding-window rate limiter.
- [Pre-Flight Tokenizer](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/finops-and-security/preflight-tokenizer): Estimate prompt tokens before provider dispatch so GoRoute can enforce token quotas and reject oversized requests before they incur upstream costs.
- [4. AI Observability — Monitoring, Tracing & Evaluation](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/modules/ai-observability): OTLP/HTTP distributed tracing with gen_ai.* attributes, Prometheus /metrics, Embedded Operator Console, Guardrails Simulator, and scrubbed logs.
- [Observability, Metrics & Health Probes](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/operations/observability): Production guide for Prometheus metrics scraping, W3C distributed traceparent propagation, and active deployment health probes.
- [Embedded Operator Web UI](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/operations/operator-ui): Comprehensive architecture and operator guide for the embedded React 19 Operator Web UI mounted at /ui/.
- [Troubleshooting & Recovery Runbooks](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/operations/troubleshooting): Diagnostic guides and production recovery runbooks for common error codes, SSRF blocks, budget exceedances, rate limits, and circuit breakers.
- [5. AI Agent Management — MCP, Tools & Agent Access](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/modules/ai-agent-management): MCP 2026-07-28 Virtual Hub, REST bridge, progressive discovery, sandboxed Stdio, A2A signed Agent Cards, gRPC, and autonomous tool loops.
- [Model Context Protocol (MCP) Overview](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/protocols/mcp-overview): Comprehensive architecture guide for Model Context Protocol (MCP) supporting 2026-07-28 Streamable HTTP, legacy SSE adapters, and virtual hub aggregation.
- [MCP Virtual Hub & Plain REST Bridge](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/protocols/mcp-hub-and-rest): Enterprise routing guide for Virtual Hub aggregation (POST /mcp), scoped server routing, curated toolsets, and the plain REST bridge (/mcp-rest/*).
- [MCP Progressive Tool Discovery](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/protocols/mcp-progressive-discovery): Scale to hundreds of enterprise tools without context bloat using 256-bit opaque handles, registry feeds, schema hydration, and OpenAPI transport.
- [MCP Stdio Process Sandboxing](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/protocols/mcp-stdio-sandboxing): Process isolation, environment variable scrubbing, execution timeouts, and binary allowlists for local command-line MCP tools.
- [Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Protocol Overview](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/protocols/a2a-overview): Architecture of the Linux Foundation A2A v1.0 protocol in GoRoute: dual HTTP/JSON-RPC bindings, SSE streaming, and transactional outbox webhooks.
- [Cryptographic Agent Cards (JCS & JWS)](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/protocols/a2a-agent-cards): RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS) and RFC 7515 JSON Web Signature (JWS) signing for A2A Agent Cards.
- [A2A OpenAI Bridge & gRPC Service](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/protocols/a2a-bridge-and-grpc): Call autonomous A2A agents using standard OpenAI SDKs via model: a2a/{slug} or high-performance native gRPC lf.a2a.v1.A2AService.
- [Server-Side Autonomous Tool Loop](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/data-plane/autonomous-tool-loop): In-process multi-turn tool execution orchestrator with safety boundaries, execution budgets, and anti-double-billing FinOps ledger tracking.
- [Engineering Guide for Coding Agents](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/operations/claude-code-and-agents): Developer guide for configuring Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Antigravity, and autonomous coding agents with deterministic verification loops.
- [Complete Configuration and Environment Reference](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/operations/configuration): Comprehensive configuration reference detailing 70+ YAML parameters, environment variable overrides, and model routing policies.
- [Deployment and Storage Architecture](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/operations/deployment-and-storage): Comprehensive production guide covering database migrations, 16 persistent schemas, and the clustered Redis keyspace and TTL matrix.
- [Kubernetes & Kustomize Deployment](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/operations/kubernetes-kustomize): Deploy GoRoute AI Gateway on Kubernetes with hardened Kustomize manifests, non-root security, health probes, PostgreSQL 16, Redis, and Prometheus.
- [Cookbook Overview](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/cookbook/overview): Task-based cookbook indexing GoRoute AI Gateway guides and all 26 runnable Go demos by user goal.

## Go SDK Handbook

- [Go SDK Overview](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/sdk/overview): Choose embedded or remote client mode and find the next SDK guides.
- [Client Initialization & Configuration](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/sdk/client-configuration): Initialize the GoRoute Go SDK for embedded or remote gateway use, then configure client options, timeouts, and model requests.
- [Chat and Streaming](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/sdk/chat-and-streaming): Send single-prompt and multi-turn requests, stream deltas, and handle cancellation.
- [Virtual Keys and FinOps](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/sdk/virtual-keys-and-finops): Create and revoke virtual keys and query spend through the Go SDK.
- [MCP and A2A](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/sdk/mcp-and-a2a): Register MCP servers and A2A agents with the Go SDK and use their gateway routes.
- [Go SDK API Reference](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/sdk/go-sdk-reference): Public constructors, options, request types, and methods in pkg/gateway.

## Runnable Go Examples

- [Interactive Demos & Curriculum Overview](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/demos/overview): Browse runnable GoRoute Go examples for AI gateway setup, provider integrations, streaming, load balancing, MCP tools, and A2A agents.
- [Hello Gateway](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/demos/hello-gateway): Build your first GoRoute Go SDK application by starting an embedded AI gateway and sending a chat completion to a configured model.
- [System Prompts](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/demos/system-prompt): Set system prompts with the GoRoute Go SDK to guide model behavior across supported provider APIs and reasoning models.
- [Streaming Tokens](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/demos/streaming-tokens): Stream chat response tokens as server-sent events with the GoRoute Go SDK and translate provider streaming formats through one gateway.
- [Temperature & Limits](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/demos/temperature-and-sampling): Control model sampling and cap generated tokens with GoRoute Go SDK options for predictable output and bounded response costs.
- [Structured JSON](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/demos/json-mode-structured-output): Build a GoRoute Go SDK example that requests schema-guided JSON output for reliable, machine-readable model responses.
- [Multi-Turn Memory](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/demos/multi-turn-conversation): Preserve conversation history across multiple chat turns with GoRoute's Go SDK request messages and an embedded gateway.
- [OpenAI Direct](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/demos/openai-direct): Connect the GoRoute Go SDK directly to OpenAI and send chat requests through its unified provider interface.
- [Anthropic Direct](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/demos/anthropic-direct): Connect the GoRoute Go SDK to Anthropic Claude and send model requests through the gateway's provider integration.
- [Google Gemini Direct](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/demos/gemini-direct): Connect a GoRoute Go application to Google Gemini and send model requests through the gateway's provider integration.
- [Local Ollama](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/demos/local-ollama): Connect GoRoute AI Gateway to a local Ollama model using a custom API base URL for on-premises or offline inference.
- [Unified Model Aliases](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/demos/unified-model-alias): Configure a logical model alias in GoRoute so applications can switch upstream AI providers without changing their model request code.
- [Tool Definition](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/demos/single-tool-definition): Define an MCP tool schema in Go and discover it through the GoRoute virtual hub before invoking it from an application.
- [Tool Execution](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/demos/tool-execution-callback): Build a Go example that invokes an MCP tool through the GoRoute gateway hub and handles its structured execution result.
- [Multi-Tool Inventory](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/demos/multi-tool-selection): Combine specialized MCP tool servers in the GoRoute virtual hub and discover tools through one aggregated registry in a Go example.
- [Autonomous Agent Loop](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/demos/autonomous-tool-loop): Build a GoRoute agent loop that analyzes a request, executes tools over multiple turns, and returns a synthesized response.
- [Outage Fallbacks](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/demos/failover-fallback-chain): Configure a GoRoute fallback target and run a Go example that sends requests to a backup model when the primary provider is unavailable.
- [Round-Robin Balancer](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/demos/round-robin-balancer): Configure round-robin model routing in GoRoute to distribute inference requests evenly across multiple backend deployments.
- [Weighted Shuffle](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/demos/weighted-shuffle-routing): Split AI traffic between model deployments with weighted shuffle routing in GoRoute for gradual rollouts and controlled traffic allocation.
- [Least Latency EWMA](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/demos/least-latency-ewma): Use GoRoute's Peak-EWMA load balancer to track provider response times and route model requests toward the lowest-latency endpoint.
- [Circuit Breakers](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/demos/circuit-breaker): Configure GoRoute circuit breaker thresholds in Go and learn how fast-failing protects services when an upstream model repeatedly errors.
- [Exact-Match Cache](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/demos/exact-match-cache): Run a Go example of GoRoute's SHA-256 exact-match cache and see how repeated deterministic prompts can avoid another provider request.
- [Rate Limiting](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/demos/sliding-window-rate-limiting): Use the Go SDK to configure sliding-window request and token quotas that protect provider limits and keep usage fair across tenants.
- [Virtual Keys & Budgets](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/demos/virtual-keys-and-budgets): Create scoped GoRoute virtual API keys, set spend budgets, track usage in micro-dollars, and revoke keys from a runnable Go example.
- [MCP Virtual Hub](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/demos/mcp-virtual-hub): Connect upstream Model Context Protocol servers to the GoRoute virtual hub and invoke their tools over JSON-RPC from a Go example.
- [A2A Agent Network](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/demos/a2a-agent-network): Register signed A2A Agent Cards and route tasks between agents through GoRoute using its OpenAI-compatible agent bridge.
- [Embedded Microservice](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/demos/embedded-http-microservice): Embed GoRoute AI Gateway in a Go HTTP service with Kubernetes liveness and readiness probes and graceful shutdown handling.

## API Reference

- [API Reference Index](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/api-reference/overview): Master API index for GoRoute AI Gateway /v1 data plane routes, admin control plane endpoints, MCP Virtual Hub, and A2A v1.0 specifications.
- [Gateway Data Plane API Reference](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/api-reference/gateway-api): Reference for all 23 GoRoute AI Gateway /v1 data plane routes (26 operations), request/response schemas, reasoning normalization, and telemetry headers.
- [Admin Control Plane API Reference](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/api-reference/admin-api): Comprehensive reference for all 12 GoRoute AI Gateway admin control plane endpoint groups with full cURL examples and JSON schemas.
- [Model Context Protocol (MCP) API Reference](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/api-reference/mcp-api): Complete specification of GoRoute MCP Virtual Hub, scoped server execution, curated toolsets, plain REST bridge, and progressive tool discovery.
- [Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Protocol API Reference](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/api-reference/a2a-api): Specification of the A2A v1.0 protocol in GoRoute AI Gateway, covering Agent Cards, dual-binding dispatch, SSE streaming, gRPC, and OpenAI bridge.

## Integrations & Ecosystem

- [Integrations Overview](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/integrations/overview): Connect OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible SDKs, coding agents, IDEs, agent frameworks, and observability backends to GoRoute AI Gateway.
- [Claude Code](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/integrations/claude-code): Configure Anthropic Claude Code to route inference, token counting, and MCP tool calls through GoRoute AI Gateway.
- [Cursor, Continue & Cline](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/integrations/cursor-and-ides): Connect Cursor, Continue.dev, and Cline IDE extensions to GoRoute AI Gateway over /v1 with Virtual Keys.
- [Codex CLI, Gemini CLI & OpenWebUI](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/integrations/codex-and-cli-agents): Route OpenAI Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and OpenWebUI through GoRoute AI Gateway via /v1 and /v1/responses.
- [OpenAI SDKs (Python & TypeScript)](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/integrations/openai-sdks): Use the official Python and TypeScript openai SDKs with GoRoute AI Gateway for chat completions, streaming, embeddings, Responses API, and Realtime WebSockets.
- [Anthropic SDKs (Python & TypeScript)](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/integrations/anthropic-sdks): Use the official Python anthropic and TypeScript @anthropic-ai/sdk packages with GoRoute AI Gateway via /anthropic/v1/messages and count_tokens.
- [Agent Frameworks (LangChain, OpenAI Agents SDK & Google ADK)](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/integrations/agent-frameworks): Connect LangChain, OpenAI Agents SDK, and Google ADK to GoRoute AI Gateway for unified model routing, MCP tool hubs, and A2A agent dispatch.
- [OpenTelemetry & Prometheus](https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/integrations/otel-and-prometheus): Configure OTLP/HTTP tracing with W3C traceparent and gen_ai.* attributes for OTel Collector, Jaeger, and Grafana Tempo, plus Prometheus /metrics.
